d: Are you ready to be part of the largest retail store in the Middle East? ABYAT, spanning an impressive 22,000 square meters and offering over 22,000 products, is your one-stop destination for all things home improvement and more. From elegant tiles and captivating wallpapers to state-of-the-art lighting solutions and stylish kitchen fixtures, we pride ourselves on offering a diverse array of top-quality products under one roof.

Established locally with a vision for excellence, ABYAT has been setting benchmarks since its inception in September 2005. With an unwavering focus on our customers, we've crafted an experience that revolves around their needs, from our meticulously designed store layouts to our unparalleled service offerings.

Expanding beyond our roots in Kuwait, ABYAT is now making waves in Saudi Arabia and soon in Qatar and the UAE. As we continue to grow, we're seeking passionate individuals to join our dynamic team and contribute to our journey of success.

Learning and Development Sr. Officer is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive training programs and onboarding processes. This role ensures new employees are effectively integrated into the organization, and existing employees receive continuous development opportunities.
q: 3–5 years of Proven experience in Training and Development, HR, Employee Engagement or similar role.
Proven experience in designing and delivering training programs.
Experience in creating training materials and resources.
Experience in developing and implementing onboarding programs.
Experience in Retail Company is highly preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Capacity to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
Familiarity with AI and design tools to enhance training Materials.
A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field is required.
Certifications in TOT, Training Material Designing and Talent Development can be beneficial.
r: Design and develop comprehensive training programs that align with the organization's goals and objectives.
Create training materials, manuals, and presentations to support various learning initiatives.
Utilize a variety of training methodologies, techniques, and platforms (e.g., e-learning, in-person, workshops).
Conduct training needs assessments to identify skill gaps and areas for development.
Collaborate with department heads to understand specific training requirements and tailor programs accordingly.
Facilitate training sessions, workshops, and seminars for employees at all levels.
Engage participants through interactive and impactful training methods.
Ensure training content is relevant, up-to-date, and aligned with current best practices.
Assess the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, surveys, and performance metrics.
Continuously improve training materials and delivery methods based on evaluation results and industry trends.
Report on training outcomes and provide recommendations for enhancements.
Ensure all training programs comply with relevant regulations and organizational policies.
Maintain accurate records of training activities, participant progress, and certifications.
Support employee development initiatives by providing coaching, mentoring, and career development resources.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within the organization.
Stay updated on industry trends, training technologies, and best practices in employee development.
Incorporate innovative approaches and tools into training and onboarding programs.
